name: xskills
description: Personal skill collection managed as a plugin: every skill is strictly classified as passive (agent auto-triggers via description) or active (explicit invocation only, with an explicit-only description prefix). Includes a workbench skill (x-skills) that lists the plugin's skills.

interface.shortDescription: Personal skill collection packaged as a plugin: passive/active classification plus an x-skills workbench.
interface.longDescription: Manages personal skills and packages them into a plugin for unified management. Every skill is strictly classified as passive (the agent auto-triggers it via the description) or active (explicit invocation only); an x-skills workbench skill lists all skills with descriptions and usage.
